Venue: Binance
Headline: Region Exclusive: Join the Affiliate Referral Festival and Refer for Rewards

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Fellow Binancians,
This festive season, Binance brings to you the Referral Festival. It’s a region exclusive event for Affiliates and the new users they invite. Refer and grow your qualified new traders, and climb the ranks to win rewards – including the chance to take home the new iPhone 18 Pro.
Promotion Period: 2026-11-17 13:00 (UTC) to 2026-12-17 23:59 (UTC)
Join Now
## Promotion A: The Top 30 Affiliates to Share a 4,000 USDT Reward Pool
## How to Participate
During the Promotion Period, eligible Binance Affiliates can participate by completing the following steps:
Step 1. Log in to your Binance account and click [Join Now].
Step 2. Invite new friends via your Referral Pro Link/ID to register on the Binance App.
Step 3. Generate qualifying Spot, Convert or Futures trading volume from your new referrals.
## Eligibility Criteria
The referred users must meet all of the following requirements to be considered qualified:
Registered through the participating Affiliate's Referral Pro Link/ID.
Completed identity verification.
Top up at least 20 USD equivalent via Fiat deposit, Buy Crypto or P2P.
Complete at least 50 USD equivalent in Spot/Futures/Convert trading volume (eligible fee-paying trading pairs only).
## Reward Structure
The top 1 ranked referrer wins the new iPhone 18 Pro by default, but they can decide to exchange this reward for 1,500 USDT.
4,000 USDT in leaderboard rewards for the top 30 ranked referrers.
## Leaderboard Reward Structure
Eligible users: Affiliates from India only.
How ranking works: Affiliates are ranked on two things together:
The number of Qualified New Traders referred,
The trading volume those traders generate.
Both minimum criteria must be satisfied to be eligible for a given rank.
Volume decides: When more affiliates qualify for a rank, rank goes to the highest referral volume.
Ties: If volume is exactly equal, the affiliate who met the requirements first takes the rank.
The leaderboard is updated with a maximum delay of 2 days (T+2).
Rank | Reward (in USDT token vouchers) | Criteria
Minimum Number of Qualified New Traders Invited During the Promotion Period | AND | Minimum Cumulative Trading Volume (in USD) Generated by New Referrals During the Promotion Period
1st Rank | New iPhone 18 Pro | 500 | $5 million
2nd Rank | 750 USDT | 250 | $2.5 million
3rd Rank | 450 USDT | 150 | $1 million
4th Rank | 300 USDT | 100 | $1 million
5th Rank | 150 USDT | 50 | $0.5 million
6th-10th Ranks | 75 USDT each | 25 | $0.5 million
11th-15th Ranks | 50 USDT each | 25 | $0.25 million
16th-20th Ranks | 30 USDT each | 15 | $0.25 million
21st-25th Ranks | 10 USDT each | 10 | $0.1 million
26th-30th Ranks | 5 USDT each | 5 | $0.1 million
Note: Tasks completed by referrals under Promotion B will also count towards Promotion A. A single referral's task completion contributes to both the referrer's Leaderboard standing in Promotion A and the referral's own reward eligibility in Promotion B.
## Promotion B: New User Exclusive - Complete Tasks and Get a Share of 4,000 USDT
Step 1. Register via a participating Affiliate's Referral Pro Link/ID and complete identity verification.
Step 2. Top up at least 20 USD equivalent via Fiat deposit, Buy Crypto or P2P.
Step 3. Trade at least 50 USD equivalent in cumulative Spot, Futures or Convert.
Share 4,000 USDT in token vouchers equally together with eligible new users.
The pool is divided equally among all eligible users, capped at a maximum of 2 USDT per user.
## Terms and Conditions
Both Promotion A and Promotion B are open only to Indian users. Users in restricted regions are disqualified from participating in the Binance Referral Program as referrers or referred users.
All affiliates are bound by the Affiliate Program Terms and are specifically reminded to follow the Code of Conduct when carrying out any activities in the capacity of an affiliate.
Trading volume from zero fee trading pairs will not be counted in Promotion A and Promotion B.
Rewards from the Promotions are mutually exclusive with certain Affiliate-exclusive campaign rewards, including but not limited to the Affiliate Dual Star Campaign. If a user earns a reward in an Affiliate-exclusive campaign, they will not be eligible to receive rewards from the Promotions. Binance reserves the right of final decision.
## Reward Distribution:
Eligible users must complete identity verification (KYC) during the Promotion Period to receive the corresponding rewards.
Promotion A rewards are distributed based on the final leaderboard after the Promotion Period ends and risk review is complete.
If an affiliate ranks at a position but does not meet that rank’s minimums, they will not qualify for that rank’s reward. In that case, the affiliate may only qualify for the rank whose minimums they do meet, if any.
Promotion B carries a total shared reward pool capped at 4,000 USDT. The pool is divided equally among all eligible users, capped at a maximum of 2 USDT per user.
If the number of eligible users would push the per-user share above the cap, each eligible user receives the 2 USDT maximum; the remainder is not redistributed.
Promotion B rewards are distributed after the Promotion Period ends and risk review is complete.
A user may receive only one Promotion B reward.
All rewards will be distributed 14 days after the Promotion Period ends, unless otherwise announced.
A new user must pass Binance's risk review to qualify. Users who fail risk review, do not complete identity verification, or are otherwise disqualified will not receive any rewards in Promotion B.
If a user is found to have engaged in fraud, wash trading, bulk/multi-account registrations, or any violation, their reward may be withheld or revoked, even if already qualified.
Neither this campaign nor Binance is endorsed by or affiliated with any third parties mentioned in the content above, including "Apple".
All third-party trademarks, brand names, product names, and logos referenced in this Promotion are the property of their respective owners. The mention of any third-party brand or product does not imply endorsement, sponsorship, or affiliation with this Promotion or with Binance.
"iPhone" is a trademark of Apple Inc., registered in the U.S. and other countries. Apple Inc. has not endorsed or sponsored this Promotion and has no association with it.
Users may be subject to Binance’s risk assessment procedure in relation to each reward or each product’s usage, and the user must pass the risk assessment in order to be eligible to earn rewards or use such a product.
There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise.

## 1. Participation Details
Users are deemed to have read and agreed to the Bitget Simple Earn Product Agreement.
Promotion rewards apply to main accounts only and are valid only during the promotion period. Institutional users are not currently eligible.
To view the Simple Earn APR boost promotion in the app, update the Bitget app to version V2.91.0 or later.
## 2. Net deposit calculation
Net deposit amount = deposit amount − withdrawal amount. Internal transfers are not counted.
The USDT activity tracks net deposits in USDT, USDC and USDGO, all converted to USDT for calculation. The BTC, ETH and XAUT activities track net deposits of the respective coins only.
## 3. Eligibility updates and effective time
The system checks each user's net deposits and subscriptions daily and automatically updates promotion eligibility between 12:00 AM and 8:00 AM (UTC+8) the following day. Once eligibility is updated, the corresponding Simple Earn product starts earning the boost; users who do not meet the conditions receive the base APR only.
Both net deposit and interest accrual follow T+1 logic. For example, a subscription or net deposit completed between 11:00 PM and 11:59:59 PM (UTC+8) on day D is counted as of 12:00 AM on day D+1, and promotion eligibility is updated on day D+2.
## 4. Boost calculation and limits
Promotion rewards apply only to principal within each promotion's boost cap. Any amount above the cap does not earn the promotion boost.
Promotion rewards are calculated daily on the user's hourly average holdings from the previous day.
Redeeming principal during the promotion period may void your eligibility or affect the bonus APR you are currently earning.
Total promotion rewards are capped and allocated on a first-come, first-served basis. Individual rewards are also capped; once your individual cap is reached, no further promotion rewards will be granted.

Users are responsible for confirming that their participation does not violate the laws and regulations that apply in their location. Bitget may adjust eligibility for this promotion based on legal, regulatory, or risk control requirements. Eligibility, eligible trading volume, and rewards are determined in accordance with these promotion rules and Bitget's final backend settlement records.
